goal: 既存の FLOW_COMMANDS と CommandDefinition を単一の option 契約の authority として拡張し、routed flow leaf の parser 受理、leaf help、group help、暗黙の help 表示を一致させる。resume と prepare を含む現行 routed leaf を動的に再列挙し、3 種類の group-help 公開経路、決定的な順序と行間、既存の validator・target guard・runtime path・拒否 lifecycle・query の独立契約を維持したことを検証可能にする。

in: Recursively enumerate src/flow/registry.js FLOW_COMMANDS and connect the current routed leaves—resume, prepare, get, set, run, and report/show—to one structured contract for positionals, rest, flags, required-value options, optional-value options, and implicit -h/--help. Derive leaf counts and direct-child group intersections at test time; keep flow query as the independent parser/help exception. Contract-side recursion is bounded to 8 registry levels, 256 routed leaves, and 1 MiB of canonical inventory/help input, with overflow failing closed and requiring a reviewed scope update. These are test-harness bounds only: they do not add a production resource policy or change command semantics, validators, target guards, runtime paths, lifecycle, or query behavior.
既存 CommandDefinition を拡張し、option の名前・alias・値種別・placeholder・説明と、group の subcommand 行の名前・summary・表示順を invariant 付きの専用 class で表現する。
leaf の Usage と Options 行、direct-child leaf 全件から導く group の共通 option、暗黙の help option を同じ option authority から投影する。command 固有の説明、例、翻訳は保持する。
sennel flow <group> --help、sennel help flow <group>、leaf を省略した sennel flow <group> の 3 公開経路を同じ subcommand row renderer と option row renderer の契約へ接続する。
get、set、run、report の direct child leaf 集合を registry から取得し、完全な option 契約の交差集合として group option を導出する。agent-work-dir の適用範囲を run のみとして扱う。
name 昇順を locale に依存しない既定順とし、表示順 metadata を許す場合の absent・equal・tie-break 規則、option の順序、名前と summary の間の 2 個以上の ASCII 空白を仕様化する。
13/14/15 文字境界、現行最長 leaf、64/65 文字の合成 name を renderer と registry integration で検証し、合成 name を実 CLI の callable name 制限にしない。
現行 parser、domain validator、target guard、runtime directory、log precedence、hook、rejection、diagnostic、exit code、execution semantics を所有者ごとに inventory 化し、help の変更がそれらを変更しないことを検証する。
query を shared routed migration、group projection、routed exhaustive matrix から除外し、bootstrapFlowQueryCli、src/flow/query.js、src/flow/query-contract.js の stdin、--request-file、help、error 契約を独立回帰で保持する。
registry contract test、real dispatcher/CLI の代表的な E2E、既存の query と lifecycle 回帰を、同じ invalid-input matrix の重複なしに接続する。
out: flow query を shared routed parser、admission、leaf/group help projection、routed exhaustive matrix へ移すこと。
command の実行意味、domain validator、target guard の判定、runtime directory の解決、retry/attempt policy、hook の lifecycle、query の schema を変更すること。
新しい command registry、help の reverse parse を authority とする実装、外部依存、agent host 固有の hook・callback・信頼操作を追加すること。
一律の ID、text、path、JSON、resource、retry 制限を新設すること。既存の上限がない箇所へ help 一貫性を理由に arbitrary limit を導入しない。
Issue 521 の restart contract と矛盾する historical audit count、revision 008、停止した historical Flow の復旧を採用すること。
docs の stale 状態をこの Spec worker が解消すること。source が正であり、docs build は別の明示的な同期作業とする。

constraints:
Issue 521 uses the 2026-09-24 Restart contract and derives the routed leaf set from the current FLOW_COMMANDS registry; historical 66/65 counts are not hard-coded acceptance data. The contract-test traversal is bounded to 8 registry levels, 256 routed leaves, and 1 MiB of canonical inventory/help input; exceeding a bound fails the contract test and requires an explicit reviewed update. These bounds constrain only test-side recursive enumeration and serialized input, not production command semantics, parser values, retry policy, or user-facing resource limits.

## Matched Spec Acknowledgment Rationale

bounded-resource-usage is acknowledged because the registry/help contract explicitly bounds recursive depth, routed-leaf count, and canonical input size, while existing retry and bulk-loading limits remain with their current owners and no new production limit is introduced.

現行 checkout の source verification では FLOW_COMMANDS は query 1、resume 1、prepare 1、get 11、set 17、run 36、report/show 1 の計 68 leaf、query を除く 67 routed leaf である。この観測値は inventory の基準であり acceptance の固定分母ではない。
既存 CommandDefinition、FLOW_COMMANDS、dispatcher、FlowTargetExpectation、flow context、container、各 command handler を責務の owner とし、同じ判断を caller や help renderer に複製しない。
option class は valueless flag、required-value、optional-value を区別する。値を取る option は placeholder と説明を持ち、alias と value kind を含む完全な契約で比較する。
暗黙の -h, --help は parser が常に認識する flag として各 routed leaf の canonical Options row に一度だけ投影する。Usage や例に再掲される文字列は option row の重複とみなさない。
group option は選択例ではなく direct child leaf 全件の完全な option 契約の交差集合から作る。report/show も registry の group として扱い、nested descendant や query を混ぜない。
既定の row 順序は locale に依存しない名前の code-unit 順とし、同名時は full command path を tie-break とする。displayOrder を採用する場合は整数を低い順、未指定を指定済みの後、同値を名前順とする。
row renderer は名前と summary の境界に少なくとも 2 個の ASCII 空白を置く。固定幅を超える名前を連結・切り詰めず、長い場合も同じ表契約を保つ。
help の metadata 読み込みは lazy command handler を import、実行、hook、runtime log、Flow state mutation しない。valid help の終了コードは 0 とし、leaf なしの group help は表示後に既存どおり 1 を返す。
parse failure、target mismatch、command failure の context resolution、runtime-log、diagnostic、pre/post/onError/finally の既存順序を、今回の help contract のために no-side-effect へ置き換えない。

agent-work-dir は --agent-work-dir /path と --agent-work-dir=/path を同じ既存 parser/resolver へ正規化し、通常の優先順位を invocation override > configured agent workDir > default とする。config.logs.dir があれば logDir を優先し、なければ agentWorkDir/logs とする。
finalize-cleanup の durable work-directory と、その durable root に対する configured log path の扱いを通常 invocation と混同しない。agentWorkDir と logDir が同一になることは要求しない。
FlowSpecId、PreparingFlowId、FlowTargetExpectation、Issue number、各 handler の domain class をそれぞれ再利用する。repair の一律 100 文字規則は導入しない。
Node.js 組み込み module のみを使い、alpha policy に従って obsolete compatibility path を温存しない。Sennel の動作は agent-independent な Node.js/CLI mechanism だけで成立させる。
変更した source と test は current worktree の既存 AGENTS.md、tests/AGENTS.md の deterministic fixture、layer ownership、backward causal coverage に従う。
design_principles: parser と presentation を別々に手書きせず、registry boundary の structured option contract を深い module の authority とする。
意味のある option と row は専用 class の constructor invariant と振る舞いで表現し、plain object の shape による暗黙契約を避ける。
display projection は command execution と分離し、help の renderer は handler の import や side effect を発生させない。
group の共通性は option 名だけでなく alias、flag/value kind、placeholder、canonical identity を比較して判定する。
既存 validator が持つ domain、形式、空値、個数、サイズ、path root、条件付き組合せをその owner に残し、shared help layer は判断を再実装しない。
明示的な target guard と runtime option を共有 collection として再利用し、個々の leaf の例外は leaf の registry entry に限定する。
locale は prose の翻訳にだけ影響し、canonical option/subcommand order と spacing には影響しない。
受け入れ結果から必要条件を逆算し、registry exhaustive matrix、public entry-point wiring、実行/拒否/side-effect 回帰をそれぞれ一つの主 layer に割り当てる。
query は独立契約として保護し、shared routed model の一般化のために query 固有の request schema や bounded reader を侵食しない。

modules.text: src/flow/registry.js は FLOW_COMMANDS、target guard の共有配列、runtime option、各 leaf の args、help、pre/post/onError/finally を保持する現在の command authority である。
src/lib/command-registry.js は FLOW_COMMANDS を CommandDefinition の tree へ投影し、metadata registry、flow group、renderHelp、help path を提供する。flowOptions の reverse parse と固定 group option は移行対象である。
src/lib/dispatcher.js の parseEntryInput、splitArgsBySpec、cli.parseArgs が routed argv の flags/options/optionalOptions/positionals/rest、equals syntax、missing/unknown/extra input を所有する。
src/help.js の HelpCommandView、HelpModel、renderCommand は help flow group の metadata surface を作る。CommandDefinition.renderHelp と重複する row rendering を共有 renderer に集約する。
src/flow.js は query を別 bootstrap に送り、通常の flow group、leaf、help、unknown selector の dispatcher entry を選ぶ。leaf なし group help の exit 1 もここで保持する。
src/sennel.js の pre-scan、src/lib/container.js の work/log path 解決、src/lib/config.js の configured agent workDir/logs.dir が runtime option の境界であり、help contract から再実装しない。

src/lib/flow-target-guard.js の FlowTargetExpectation/FlowTargetBinding と src/flow/lib/flow-context.js の buildFlowCommandHookContext が五つの target guard、identity、mismatch、resolved execution root の owner である。
各 src/flow/lib/run-*.js、get-*.js、set-*.js handler は domain value、file/directory、state-dependent combination、mutation、envelope failure の owner であり、registry はそれらを複製しない。
src/flow/query.js と src/flow/query-contract.js は bootstrapFlowQueryCli が読む request-file/stdin、bounded JSON、response、help/error の独立 authority であり、FLOW_COMMANDS の shared routed migration から除外する。
既存の src/flow/registry.js lifecycle hook と dispatcher runtime-log は execution、rejection、failure の副作用境界を保持する。help metadata はこれらを起動しない。

tests/integration/lib/command-registry.test.js は registry subtree と parser projection の integration layer、tests/e2e/help.test.js は public help wiring の代表的な CLI layer、tests/integration/flow/query.test.js は query regression layer である。
tests/AGENTS.md が定める unique temporary work root、immutable seed、production API setup、process boundary の限定を、新しい help contract test と E2E fixture に適用する。

data_flow.text: FLOW_COMMANDS の leaf args と明示 option metadata を CommandDefinition が CommandOption として保持し、parser spec と leaf/group help の両方へ投影する。
各 CommandOption は canonical name、aliases、value kind、placeholder、summary、source owner を検証し、flag/required/optional の parser 配列を一箇所から生成する。
dispatcher は projected args を parseEntryInput へ渡し、-h/--help、flags、required options、optional options、positionals、rest、equals form を現行順序で解釈する。
leaf help は command-specific Usage/prose/example を保持しつつ、canonical Options section を CommandOption row から描画する。internal _rawArgs、resolved target、injected runtime state は option inventory に入れない。
group help は direct child leaf の row を CommandHelpRow に変換し、displayOrder/名前順で並べ、共通 option の完全交差を group option section に投影する。
flow.js の flow <group> --help と flow <group>、help.js の help flow <group> は同じ row renderer を利用する。経路固有の heading、prose、終了処理だけを各入口に残す。
help 以外の argv は通常どおり dispatcher context、target guard、runtime log、handler、post/onError/finally を通り、structured help model は execution path の authority にならない。
agent-work-dir は pre-scan と既存 resolver の同じ option value として正規化され、configured logs.dir、durable finalize root、runtime log writer の既存優先順位へ渡される。
query argv は flow.js の先頭分岐から bootstrapFlowQueryCli へ直接渡され、shared option intersection、target guard、routed parser matrix を経由しない。
contract test は registry traversal と projected parser/help の一致を exhaustive に確認し、E2E は三つの help path、代表的な guard/exit/runtime、長名/順序だけを確認する。

background:
Issue 521 addresses the mismatch between the FLOW_COMMANDS parser contract and displayed help. The authoritative 2026-09-24 restart contract supersedes the historical audit counts and unresolved revision 008. It requires current-registry re-enumeration, a shared structured option model, reuse of existing owners, preservation of rejection lifecycle and runtime paths, and a per-leaf inventory and owner map.

Source verification found that src/flow/registry.js owns FLOW_COMMANDS leaf args, help, lazy handlers, lifecycle hooks, target metadata, and runtime metadata; src/lib/command-registry.js projects those entries into CommandDefinition and currently reverse-parses hand-written help; src/lib/dispatcher.js owns splitArgsBySpec, parseEntryInput, cli.parseArgs, implicit -h/--help, required and optional values, equals syntax, positional/rest handling, and unknown/missing/extra input boundaries; and src/help.js has a second fixed-width subcommand renderer. The Spec therefore makes the registry-bound structured option model the authority for parser, Usage, Options, leaf help, and direct-child group help, while retaining command prose, examples, and locale text.

The current checkout enumerates 68 FLOW_COMMANDS leaves: query, resume, prepare, get 11, set 17, run 36, and report/show 1. The 67 routed leaves exclude query. Query remains the independent bootstrapFlowQueryCli contract owned by src/flow/query.js and src/flow/query-contract.js, including stdin, --request-file, bounded request/response, cursor, schema, help, and error behavior. Current inventory and tests must derive their denominator and group intersections from the registry rather than hard-code historical 66, 65, 67, or 34/36 counts.

The structured model uses dedicated option and command-row classes with constructor invariants. An option records canonical name, aliases, flag/required-value/optional-value kind, placeholder, and description. A row records name, summary, optional display order, and full path. Implicit -h, --help is one explicit option row. Group options are the full option-contract intersection of every direct child leaf, including aliases and value kind; therefore --agent-work-dir belongs to run and not get, set, or report/show. Canonical name order is locale-independent, with explicit display order lower-first, absent-last, and name as the tie-breaker. Rows use at least two ASCII spaces between name and summary, including the 13/14/15 character boundary, recover-missing-producer-artifact, and renderer-only synthetic 64/65 character names; synthetic names do not create a production command-name limit.

The per-leaf inventory distinguishes parser syntax from domain validation. Positionals, rest, flags, required-value options, optional-value options, and implicit help are enumerated from the registry. FlowSpecId, PreparingFlowId, FlowTargetExpectation, target binding, canonical file map, review evidence, task-review host filtering, and each command handler retain ownership of format, domain, conditional combinations, path roots, and existing limits. Internal _rawArgs, resolved targets, injected runtime state, and runtime-log metadata are not public options. Existing explicit limits remain owner contracts; an absent limit remains absent, and help consistency does not authorize a universal validator or arbitrary resource policy.

Verification uses registry traversal plus real dispatcher/CLI behavior for leaf help, all three group-help routes, parser acceptance, guard matches and mismatches, runtime paths, rejection order, lifecycle hooks, diagnostics, and exit codes. It assigns hook, configuration, generated-artifact, side-effect, and query checks to their existing owners and behavior-level tests. The bounded test contract is explicit: the contract traversal fails closed above 8 nested registry levels, 256 routed leaves, or 1 MiB of canonical inventory/help input. These are test-harness safety bounds and review triggers, not new production command limits; the current three-level routed tree and 67 routed leaves are within them.

The bounded-resource-usage exception is intentional only for the registry/help contract: recursive traversal, retries, and bulk input are never unbounded in the test harness, and existing retry and bulk-data limits remain owned by their current modules. A bound or retry policy change is outside this help-contract scope and requires a separate reviewed change.

requirements.desc:
既存の FLOW_COMMANDS と CommandDefinition を唯一の routed command authority とし、専用 class による option/row invariant を導入する。CommandOption は canonical name、alias、value kind（flag、required-value、optional-value）、placeholder、description、parser name を保持し、CommandHelpRow は name、summary、optional displayOrder、full path を保持する。constructor は空名、重複 alias、kind と placeholder の不整合、summary 欠落を拒否する。新しい並列 registry、help reverse parse、handler ごとの独自 option authority は作らない。 各 routed Flow entry の構造化 option 表示 metadata の concrete authority は、FLOW_COMMANDS entry に持たせる optionDefinitions field と、同じ registry が所有する共通定義（FLOW_TARGET_GUARD_OPTIONS と FLOW_RUN_OPTIONS を含む）とする。既存の CommandDefinition factory はこの definitions から CommandOption instance を生成し、同じ definitions から parser の args/options 投影と leaf/group help の option row を生成する。raw help は Usage、command-specific prose、examples、locale のための prose として保持し、description、placeholder、alias、kind、summary の source にはしない。structured projection/renderer は routed FLOW_COMMANDS にだけ opt-in し、NamespaceDispatcher が扱う docs、check、metrics、spec、hook と core/plugin の non-flow help metadata/render behavior は既存契約を保持する。

The parser projection must normalize every declared alias and required/optional-value form in parseEntryInput/splitArgsBySpec to canonical keys before cli.parseArgs. The defined --name=value forms and existing duplicate, missing, unknown-option, extra-input, and positional/rest outcomes are part of the same parser contract consumed by the help rows.

The current FLOW_COMMANDS registry is the authority for a complete per-leaf input inventory and owner map for every routed leaf; query is the separate bootstrapFlowQueryCli exception and is excluded from this shared inventory and matrix. The current checkout has resume 1, prepare 1, get 11, set 17, run 36, and report/show 1, for 67 routed leaves. The denominator is re-enumerated at test time.

Use the notation P=positionals in declaration order, R=rest with its minimum count, F=valueless flags, O=required-value options, OO=optional-value options, and H=the implicit -h/--help flag. A missing category means that category is absent. H is accepted on every routed leaf, is represented once in the canonical Options section, and is not passed to the handler. The value contract is owned by the named command or value class, not inferred from a shared spelling. `--spec` on resume is a FlowSpecId: a non-empty literal matching [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*, with no double dot and no trailing dot or .lock; `--spec` on run gate is an existing file path resolved by run-gate against its execution root, and it may be relative or absolute only as that owner permits. `--spec-id` is the same FlowSpecId and must be paired with --version; --version is a positive safe integer. `--base` on prepare and lint is a Git branch name resolved by the existing Git owner. `--issue` is a positive integer and is validated by prepare or set-init/set-issue owners. `--title`, --request, --text, --message, --answer, --why, --considered, --dropped-reason, --search, --notes, --record-evidence, --remaining-risk, and free-form --reason values are UTF-8 strings with non-empty trimmed content where their owner requires a value; there is no new universal text maximum.

The five shared target guards are owned by FlowTargetExpectation and FlowTargetBinding in src/lib/flow-target-guard.js. --expect-no-issue is a valueless boolean and conflicts with --expect-issue. --expect-issue is a positive safe integer. --expect-spec is a FlowSpecId. --expect-run-id is a non-empty trimmed target token of at most 300 characters; it is not a generic 100-character ID. --expect-binding is a base64url serialized version-2 binding, at most 32 KiB, and cannot be combined with conflicting explicit target fields. A matching guard selects the same run/spec/Issue/authority; a mismatch is rejected before command-owned mutation. Missing guards retain each command's existing behavior.

--run-id has owner-specific meanings. On prepare it selects a PreparingFlowId with the existing safe identifier grammar and 200-character maximum. On set request, set note, set auto, and auto-check it selects the preparing-flow owner with that same rule. On get status it is the optional positional selector. On get runtime-log it is runId or runId#sequence, where sequence is a positive decimal integer; an explicit --sequence must match the suffix. Other occurrences of --expect-run-id are target guards, not PreparingFlowIds. --task-id is an existing canonical task identifier resolved by the active Flow; --normalized-finding-id is an existing issue-log finding identifier; neither gets a new global regex or length rule.

Other domains are explicit: get check target is dirty, gh, impl, or finalize; get prompt kind is a prompt-registry key; get artifact logicalKey is spec.record or acceptance.review; get guardrail phase is VALID_GUARDRAIL_PHASES with impl mapped to task-impl and --format is json or default Markdown; get runtime-log --format accepts only json and --sequence is positive decimal. set step id is an existing step identifier and status is VALID_STEP_STATUSES. set draft-answer questionId must be the selected Draft question, question-revision is a non-negative safe integer, and --drop is mutually exclusive with answer/why/considered while dropped-reason requires --drop. set broad action is on and --step is implement, impl-review, or impl-gate. set policy value is nonblocking. set nonblocking-decision --choice is repair, retry, or continue; reason is non-empty and continue requires non-empty --remaining-risk; --expect-evidence-digest is a lowercase SHA-256 digest. set metric phase and counter are VALID_PHASES and VALID_METRIC_COUNTERS. set approval requires --approved, --confirmed-at is ISO 8601, and --notes is at most 2000 characters. set acceptance-decision --choice is accept_risk_and_continue or abort. set auto value is on or off.

set issue-log requires --step and a trimmed --reason of at least 20 characters. trigger, resolution, and guardrail-candidate, when present, are trimmed strings of at least 10 characters. --repair-ref-commit is 7 to 40 hexadecimal characters; --repair-ref-file is a non-empty path; --task-id must exist in the current task set. set retry action is reset, kind is gate or review, phase is respectively gate phases task-impl or integration, or review phases draft, draft-questions, draft-coverage, spec, test, or impl; --yes and --reason are required by the existing RetryRecovery owner.

Run-specific values retain their owners. --approve is the exact non-empty dispatcher approval token. --phase on recover-review-pass is draft-questions, draft-coverage, spec, test, or impl; on review it is a VALID_REVIEW_PHASES value; on gate it is a VALID_GATE_PHASES value. reopen-draft --category is task-addition or spec-correction, with spec-correction requiring its existing target guards and reason. reconcile-task-review --dry-run previews, --yes requires the exact --expect-digest, and --reason is 20 to 500 characters. filter-task-review --exclusions is a JSON array whose entries have exactly non-empty findingId and reason; the host filter permits at most 256 findings and rejects unknown or duplicate IDs. Its four expect values are lineage inputs owned by that command: attempt ID is non-empty, and review/source/catalog fingerprints are SHA-256 digests. --task-id, --json, --base, and final-regression values are validated by their run-* owners. --json for update-overview is an object with modules, data_flow, and decisions arrays; each entry is at most 500 characters. --record-category is an existing final-regression category: existing, environment, sandbox, timeout, dependency, out_of_scope, or flaky_suspected; --record-evidence and --remaining-risk are required for explicit out_of_scope or flaky_suspected recording.

Path contracts remain owner-specific. --agent-work-dir is a file-system path resolved by the existing root/config resolver; invocation override has priority over config.agent.workDir and .tmp, while config.logs.dir controls logDir when present and otherwise logs are under agentWorkDir/logs. Both slash and equals option forms must feed the same resolver; finalize-cleanup retains its durable-root policy. run gate --spec is a file path and must exist when supplied. set review-evidence --file must be an existing bounded regular JSON file inside the active spec directory; its existing review-evidence limit is 1 MiB. get context path is an analysis/file path resolved by get-context; with no path it is list mode, and --search is keyword text. set files paths are one or more normalized repository-relative paths owned by CanonicalFileMap; reqId must be a requirement id. Do not require output directories to exist before the owner creates them.

Existing resource policies are recorded without adding new ones: review evidence is bounded to 1 MiB; Task Review exclusions are bounded to 256 entries; update-overview entries are bounded to 500 characters; approval notes are bounded to 2000 characters; nonblocking reason and remaining-risk strings are bounded to 2000 characters; review subprocess retry count and delay remain the existing run-review owner values of 2 and 30 seconds. The set-files command has no additional CLI count or aggregate-size rule beyond CanonicalFileMap and its Store. get-context keeps its existing analysis/prompt traversal and read policies; this Spec adds no replacement depth, count, or read-size rule. Query request-file size, collection, and depth bounds remain only in src/flow/query-contract.js and are regression-tested separately. No retry, attempt, path, text, or JSON policy is copied into a new common validator.

The shared registry option model projects parser args, leaf help, and group help, and the direct-child intersection compares full option contracts including aliases and value kind. Contract tests use the inventory to cover every routed leaf, required-value space and equals syntax, optional positional/rest cardinality, owner validation, implicit help, and the query exclusion. Focused real CLI tests cover all three group-help entry points, group intersections, ordering and spacing, guard match/mismatch, runtime-path forms, exit status, and one behavior-level assertion for each retained public surface. Existing command modules, validators, hooks, configuration, generated artifacts, side effects, and lifecycle transitions remain the owners of execution behavior.

At the CLI entry point, every user-facing argument in this inventory shall be validated before it is passed to any internal function. The entry point shall invoke the named command or value owner's existing validator for the applicable type, format, domain, conditional, path, and size rules; internal context and injected runtime state remain outside this boundary.

The shared routed layer performs syntax parsing and context/target resolution only. Each leaf's existing command owner remains responsible for domain validation, which must complete before that handler's command-owned execution or mutation; no new registry-wide validator is introduced. Existing rejection diagnostics, target-guard, runtime-log, and lifecycle ordering remain unchanged.

全 routed leaf の help は parser contract と一致する。各 leaf の canonical Options section は projected F/O/OO と暗黙 H を漏れなく一度ずつ表示し、値付き option は kind に対応する placeholder と説明を持つ。Usage、command-specific prose、examples、locale は保持する。現在の代表例である sennel flow run abort --help は --force、--agent-work-dir <path>、5 種の target guard、-h, --help を表示し、query の help は query-contract.js の独立表示のままにする。 routed leaf の help は dispatcher の parseEntryInput の help shortcut から shared leaf renderer を呼んで生成する。renderer は raw entry.help から Usage、command-specific prose、examples、locale を保持し、structured CommandOption rows を Options section に投影する。help flag がある場合も raw entry.help をそのまま返さず、同じ parser/option authority による row を使う。

The public routing boundary is explicit: src/sennel.js, src/flow.js, and src/help.js must delegate routed Flow leaf and group help to the same structured renderer, and none of those routes may return raw entry.help for a routed command. The renderer and parser consume the same definitions, so aliases and optional-value forms are normalized to canonical parser keys before cli.parseArgs, with the specified equals, duplicate, missing, unknown, and extra-input behavior preserved.

group help は全 direct child leaf の row と option intersection を projection する。current group の child set は registry から取得し、get/set/run/report の全 leaf を含める。--agent-work-dir <path> は run group の共通 option として表示し、get/set/report group には表示しない。5 target guard は各 child の完全契約が共通の場合だけ表示し、単なる option 名の一致ではなく alias、kind、placeholder を比較する。group の候補に query、nested descendant、未選択の代表例を含めない。

subcommand row と option row は deterministic に描画される。既定は locale-independent な canonical name 昇順、displayOrder を採用する場合は lower-first/absent-last/equal-name-tie の規則、option は canonical name 順とする。同じ group の sennel flow <group> --help、sennel help flow <group>、sennel flow <group> の row order と padding は同じであり、各 row は name と summary の間に ASCII 空白を少なくとも 2 個置く。13/14/15 文字、現行最長 recover-missing-producer-artifact、合成 64/65 文字を検証するが、production command name length limit は追加しない。

The three public group-help paths delegate to the same subcommand-row and option-row renderer; src/sennel.js and src/flow.js must not bypass it by returning raw group help.

The help projection change must not change execution responsibility, validation, guard evaluation, lifecycle, diagnostics, or exit-code behavior. This contract applies to every current routed leaf: resume; prepare; get status, resolve-context, check, prompt, artifact, qa-count, guardrail, issue, next-action, context, and runtime-log; set step, request, issue, note, draft-answer, files, review-evidence, broad, policy, nonblocking-decision, metric, approval, issue-log, init, retry, acceptance-decision, and auto; run seal-handoff, dispatch, recover-review-pass, gate, review, auto-check, finalize-commit, finalize-merge, finalize-sync, finalize-cleanup, abort, sync, reopen-draft, repair-plan-gate, settle-failure, settle-review-transition, recover-missing-producer-artifact, recover-spec-gate-repair, recover-draft-execution, reconcile-task-review, filter-task-review, recover-finalization, recover-task-execution-overrun, claim-next-action, settle-gate-transition, start-task, complete-task, update-overview, lint, test-execute, requirement-test-gate, test-result-review, retro, final-regression, acceptance-review, and report; and report/show. The list is regenerated from FLOW_COMMANDS, not used as a hard-coded denominator.

For each listed leaf, a successful owner-admitted invocation means that its declared positional/rest cardinality, parser syntax, existing owner validation, and any applicable target guard are satisfied; it returns process exit code 0 and performs only its documented command behavior. Expected owner-admitted domain or no-result failures, including get runtime-log when the requested log is absent and report show when its pointer or report is absent, retain their existing exit code 1 and diagnostic behavior. Explicit -h or --help is valid, prints the leaf help, returns 0, and does not execute the handler, lifecycle hook, runtime log operation, or mutation. A group with no leaf prints group help but returns 1, while an unknown group or leaf, missing required value, unknown option, extra positional, invalid owner value, target mismatch, or command/lifecycle failure returns 1. Query is outside this shared contract and keeps its independent query exit and error behavior.

The parser projection from the shared option definitions through parseEntryInput and splitArgsBySpec into cli.parseArgs must normalize aliases and required/optional-value forms to canonical keys, accept the specified --name=value forms, and preserve existing duplicate, missing/unknown-option, extra-input, and P/rest behavior. Preserve FlowTargetExpectation and FlowTargetBinding matching, mismatch, mutual exclusion, and identity checks before command-owned mutation. Preserve the existing pre, post, onError, and finally ordering, envelope diagnostics, and runtime log behavior, including the current fact that parse failures may resolve context or open a log. src/sennel.js must normalize both --agent-work-dir /path and --agent-work-dir=/path before initContainer so they reach the same existing resolver: invocation override, then configured agent.workDir, then .tmp. config.logs.dir controls logDir when set, otherwise it is agentWorkDir/logs, and finalize-cleanup retains its durable-root policy.
